summary.text: Will Guzzardi is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 39th District, serving since January 2015, and is listed as Assistant Majority Leader, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Guzzardi holds a B.A. from Brown University and was formerly a journalist at Huffington Post Chicago and head writer for the University of Chicago Office of College Admissions.
It says Guzzardi lives in Chicago's Logan Square neighborhood and co-chairs the Illinois House Progressive Caucus.
